newsitem.title: USA: Hillary Clinton wins Grammy award.
newsitem.headline: Hillary Clinton wins Grammy award.

text.p: First lady Hillary Clinton on Wednesday won a Grammy award -- the U.S. music industry's top accolade -- for a recorded version of "It Takes A Village," her best-selling book about child-rearing.
Clinton's award was announced in a private, non-televised ceremony held before the glittering 39th annual awards show to be broadcast from New York City's Madison Square Garden.

Clinton won in the category of best spoken word or non-musical album. Her recording is a three-hour reading of her book, which sparked debate during last year's presidential campaign over issues of child-rearing and community involvement.
She beat out other nominees including radio personality Garrison Keillor's "The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn" and braodcaster Charles Kuralt's "America."

Other nominees in the category were "Harry S. Truman: A Journey to Independence," featuring Lauren Bacall and Gregory Peck, and "Grow Old Along With Me The Best is Yet to Be," featuring actors Ed Asner and Ellen Burstyn.
